Definition: to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to kindle, burn, set on fire; 1a) (Qal) to kindle; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be kindled; 1b2) to be left desolate; 1c) (Hiphil) to set on fire, kindle
